_readme: Copy to sources.json and edit. Without a sources.json the script uses built-in defaults (the per-user skill folders of common agents, plus project skills under ~/GitHub, ~/src, ~/code and ~/projects). kind: installed = an agent lists these in every session; project = loaded inside that repo; catalog = cloned but not installed. Installed folders are scanned one level deep (what agents load); set recursive: true to scan a whole tree. Globs (*) are allowed; missing paths are skipped.

budgets._readme: Characters of skill names + descriptions an agent lists before truncating. Estimates: set them to what your agents actually allow.
